name: Universe
description: A Geometry Dash utility and local-practice toolkit. Noclip is restricted to Practice Mode by Safe Mode.

click-sound.name: Global click sound
click-sound.description: Play the supplied sound for mouse clicks and Android screen taps throughout Geometry Dash.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Required for Noclip. Restricts collision bypass to Practice Mode and cannot be disabled while Noclip is enabled.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: Bypass object and slope collisions only in Practice Mode while Safe Mode is enabled.

practice-tools.name: Practice tools
practice-tools.description: Enable local practice and testing helpers.
